body:
## Content proofreading checklist, first pass (ruling 3 of 2026-09-18)

Scope: 16 reference contracts, 2 guide documents, 5 example READMEs. Categories checked per document: inconsistent with actual candidate behaviour, outdated, in conflict with a gate token, in conflict with an accepted decision record.

**Items already confirmed by evidence in this session** (each was found while doing acceptance or repository work, so it is not speculation):

1. **`docs/v1-physical-acceptance.md`, E1 step 6** - the runbook says the step is taken on "the normal E1 Widgets application", but that path is structurally unreachable there (the single policy transition runs only from the view-only state). The payload ruling that `remote-support-showcase` carries it is recorded on #109 but never reflected in the runbook. Fix: state the carrier and why.
2. **`docs/v1-physical-acceptance.md`, E1 step 9** - the return-to-view-only half is now deterministically measurable because the showcase gained an application-wide `Ctrl+I` entry (PR #160). The runbook should name that entry instead of leaving the step to keyboard navigation.
3. **`docs/v1-ga-acceptance.md`, section 5, E5 row** - the row claims E5 retains "explicit local start/stop, view-only safe initial policy, explicit control enablement, true listener-versus-connected status, reconnect/session diagnostics and meaningful Widgets/text interaction", but the release input `tests/product-e2e/showcase_product_fit.py` launches with `--auto-start --remote-input` and asserts only client counts, a pointer/key line and listener release. It exercises neither the safe initial policy nor explicit enablement, so the claim and the harness do not match. Fix: either extend the harness or narrow the row.
4. **`docs/adr/0005-documentation-zones-and-repository-structure.md`, decision 5** - it records the reference zone as English-canonical with *optional* Chinese mirrors, which the ruling of 2026-09-18 has superseded by making five integrator-facing reference documents **required** Chinese mirrors. Fix: a follow-up entry naming the five and the resolved mirror location (`docs/zh/reference/PATH`, since `docs/en/` is the *English* mirror root by the declared convention).
5. **`docs/reference/known-limitations.md`** - it does not state the EGLFS/Wayland-class "no QPA delegate" limitation, which is a limitation rather than a capability claim and therefore belongs there rather than only in compatibility/ADR-0004.
6. **Example READMEs** - `remote-support-showcase/README.md` documents both the logo and the `Ctrl+I` entry; the other four example READMEs do not mention the project logo that PR #160 adds to them.
7. **`docs/repository-layout.md`, build entry points** - it describes `compile.cmd` refusing to mix modes and printing the exact command. The message it prints is currently a command the script itself rejects (#141), and the workaround lives in the two guides (PR #155) while the layout authority does not mention it.

**Not yet examined at all** (requires reading each document; listed so the gap is explicit rather than implied): internal consistency across the 16 reference contracts - `compatibility.md` versus `known-limitations.md` versus `architecture.md` on embedded/EGLFS claims; `security.md` versus `security-model.md` overlap; `v1-api-stability.md` versus `sdk-consumption.md`; `versioning.md` versus the roadmap; and the two guide documents against the current `compile.cmd`/`clean.cmd` behaviour.

This list is the checklist the fixes will follow; nothing here is a claim that the documents are otherwise correct.
